p01.quote: Results: "Of the 197,994 cells from the 58 libraries with a matched short-read library, 160,891 (81.3%) were also" recovered

p02.quote: Results: "a mean Pearson correlation of 0.81 across donors (range 0.71-0.89)"

p03.quote: Results: "144 precisely defined cell types grouped into 34 broad cell classes"

p04.quote: Results: "two replicate long-read libraries prepared from the same tissue agreed at r = 0.945 and rho = 0.894"

p05.quote: Only Pearson (0.81) and Spearman (0.82) are reported. No Kendall tau appears in the paper. Trap item.

p06.quote: Results and Fig. 1b: "peaking at 55.3 mm at E16.5"

p07.quote: Results: "We profiled 698,631 cells across 15 libraries, 14 of which passed quality control"

p09.quote: Horn length is reported for CONTROL, E16.5, PPD1, PPD7, PPD30 and PPD90 only. There is no PPD60 group. Trap item.

p10.quote: The study is mouse only; there is no human cohort. Trap item.

p11.quote: Abstract: "resolves four subtypes (Metal-Ion Stress, Neuroinflammatory, Synaptic Integrity, and Tissue Remodeling)"

p12.quote: Down syndrome-associated AD is named only as a cohort to be added in future work. No such nuclei are in the atlas and no count is reported. Trap item.
